title: Stop the first usage sweep freezing main for a minute after launch
notes: Measured: first sweep reads every ~/.claude/projects log on main's thread: 4,585 files, 4.53 GB, 56 s, 46 CPU-s, longest hold 477 ms (one 128.8 MB log). In the app with 0.5 GB of logs: 22 main stalls over 50 ms in 3.6 s, worst 411 ms; a keystroke echo took 356 ms. Where: src/main/usage/usage-sweep.ts FIRST_SWEEP_MS, usage-store.ts sweepUsage/countInto. Fix (medium): persist per-file size and counts in userData so a launch reads only appended bytes; parse off main's thread. Rerun: measure.mjs usage-sweep and lag. From profiling card dca04e6f, docs/performance/history.md 2026-11-02.

comments.body: The 477 ms longest hold (and the 56 s / 46 CPU-s) came from a copy of the sweep that skipped Date.parse, tokensOf and the sample push per line, so it is a floor. usage-sweep now runs the app's own sweepUsage; rerun it before comparing a fix against these. See docs/performance/history.md.

Rerun with the app's own sweepUsage (PR #166): 4,608 files, 4.55 GB, 17.9 s, 22.6 CPU-s, longest event-loop hold 182 ms. The 56 s / 477 ms in the notes came from a hand-written copy that overstated it. The in-app lag numbers (22 stalls over 50 ms, worst 411 ms, a 356 ms keystroke with 0.5 GB of logs) stand.

Shipped in #172: the usage sweep runs on its own worker thread. Main's longest hold during the first sweep of 4.57 GB went from 148-165 ms to 1-2 ms; in the app, 6-8 stalls over 50 ms after launch went to 0. Not done: counts are not saved between launches, so each launch still reads every log, off main's thread.
